name: PipSync 02 - Read-only Signals to Telegram or Slack

parameters.content:
## Safe-by-default signal summary

The workflow starts with synthetic data. The documented `GET /signals` node and both notification nodes are disabled. Configure a read-only PipSync Header Auth credential, enable the GET node, set `useSyntheticData` to false, then enable exactly one notification node.
